name: com.clevertap.android.directcall.receivers.CallNotificationActionReceiver
description: When someone taps Answer, Decline, Hang up, or a missed-call action on a CleverTap DirectCall notification, this receiver sends that choice to the call screen or call handler.
disableEffect: Users may not be able to answer or decline an incoming DirectCall from its notification, hang up, or use a missed-call action.
